verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch's Community Edition is documented as free/MIT-licensed and explicitly supports self-hosting on your own infrastructure with full data ownership, with an admin dashboard for server configuration; community comments confirm it's actually installed and self-hosted via Docker/git clone. missing for 10: independent third-party verification of a smooth self-host setup (one community comment notes confusion about install steps) and no probe evidence of a successful self-hosted instance running.
